codex_feasibility.storage: LOCAL (copied from Codex 暫存目錄, SHA-256 checked 28/28)

units: meters; world frame of the r004 static scene (Blender, Z up)
clearance_method: exact active mesh face cross-sections at each vertex-height interval through 0..1.700001m; deduplicated XY; walls/screens/vehicle; no bounding box substituted for joined shell
occluder_method: XY intervals solid at every slice height 0.25, 1.45, 2.65, 3.05 m (one per shell topology interval up to the 3.2 m top; every camera is at z <= 3.0 m and every body point at z <= 1.85 m, so a 2D sight line crossing one is blocked in 3D). Vehicle, door lintels and the x=15 parapet are not occluders.

R004_WEST_ENTRY.note: measured active shell: jamb inner faces y=±0.7, z0..2.4; v2 assumed width1.2 was incorrect

PORTAL_R101.note: active shell and source PORTAL_R101 endpoints agree; v2 assumed center7.75 was incorrect

render_camera_sets_basis: scenario card v1 section 2-3 and v2 section 1 (A4 renders CAM_ENTRY for lookup only; still rendered, so it counts for spawn/exit visibility)
